description: This file contains assembly routines for thread context switching and system call handling on ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R CPUs within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for saving/restoring thread context, handling FPU state, and managing system calls.

methods.name: z_arm_do_swap
methods.description: Performs thread context switch by saving current thread state and restoring the next thread state, including FPU and MPU states if configured.

methods.name: z_arm_svc
methods.description: Handles system calls, including context switching, IRQ offloading, and kernel exceptions, with support for user space and privilege management.

methods.name: z_arm_cortex_r_svc
methods.description: Simplified system call entry point for Cortex-R, invoking context switch.
